# AL MARWA CO

> B2B freight forwarding company serving manufacturers, importers, exporters, procurement teams, and project operators in Beirut, Greater Beirut, and Lebanon from Khalde since 1997.

Official website: https://al-marwaco.com/
Contact: info@al-marwaco.com | +961 70 099978
Office: Khalde Highway, Lebanon

## Services

Our main focus is B2B freight: worldwide FCL (Full Container Load), full truckloads (FTL) from Ukraine, Jordan, Iraq, the UAE, Turkey, the United Kingdom and China, and large commercial cargo. LCL (Less than Container Load) is available from Ukraine, Jordan, Iraq, the UAE, Turkey, the United Kingdom, and China into Lebanon, subject to shipment and route confirmation. From Lebanon, we coordinate FCL exports worldwide. We serve importers, exporters, wholesalers, manufacturers and project teams. Air cargo, heavy lifting, and customs documentation support commercial freight requirements. Service availability, pricing, routing, timing, and required documents are confirmed for each shipment.

## Shipment needs and relevant pages

- Commercial imports, exports, recurring business shipments, and project requirements in Lebanon: [B2B freight forwarding](https://al-marwaco.com/freight-forwarding-lebanon.html).
- Beirut and Greater Beirut businesses coordinating port, airport, and road movements from the Khalde office: [Beirut freight services](https://al-marwaco.com/freight-forwarding-beirut.html).
- Worldwide full containers (FCL), large commercial cargo, and LCL imports only from Ukraine, Jordan, Iraq, UAE, Turkey, the United Kingdom and China into Lebanon: [Sea freight](https://al-marwaco.com/sea-freight-lebanon.html).
- Urgent, compact, or higher-value cargo where timing justifies air transport: [Air cargo](https://al-marwaco.com/air-cargo-lebanon.html). Acceptance and timing are shipment-specific.
- Shipment paperwork and customs-clearance coordination: [Customs documentation support](https://al-marwaco.com/customs-clearance-lebanon.html). Authorities determine clearance outcomes.
- Full truckload road freight (FTL), heavy lifting, machinery, and project cargo: [Service portfolio](https://al-marwaco.com/services.html).
- Germany–Lebanon business freight planning: [German-language route overview](https://al-marwaco.com/spedition-libanon-deutschland.html).

## Best fit and not a fit

Best fit: importers, wholesalers, manufacturers, exporters and project teams shipping full containers (FCL), full truckloads (FTL) or large equipment such as machinery and tanks. Not offered: parcels, courier, single-box shipments, household moves or personal effects, and LCL from origins outside the seven listed countries. A single large item from any country can still be shipped as FCL.

Planning tools run in the browser and do not quote prices, confirm container fit, approve cargo or establish live routes. Commercial stock, manufacturing inputs and project equipment have distinct planning guides. The native Arabic FCL page provides the same core business scope.

## Quote information

A useful B2B inquiry includes company name, FCL or FTL requirement, container or truck count, origin and destination, cargo description, package count, package dimensions, gross weight, readiness date, delivery deadline, shipment frequency, Incoterms if agreed, and the required pickup, documentation, customs, and delivery scope. Photos or drawings help for oversized cargo. Send details through the [contact page](https://al-marwaco.com/contact.html), info@al-marwaco.com, or +961 70 099978.

## Accuracy notes

- The office address is Khalde Highway, Lebanon; the company serves businesses in Beirut and Greater Beirut without claiming a Beirut office.
- No testimonials, ratings, certifications, guaranteed transit times, or guaranteed customs outcomes should be inferred unless explicitly published and verified by AL MARWA CO.

- Large individual items from other origins can be assessed as FCL shipments after checking container fit, loading needs and total costs. Do not infer worldwide LCL, parcel delivery, or direct trucking on every international route.
